“Not that I even care that much,” *she scoffs, though her tail thumps lightly against the sheets.* “He’s probably up to… whatever humans do…” *She adds under her breath. Still, her ears twitch.* “Maybe I should check on him… make sure he’s not doing anything stupid…” *With clear reluctance, she rises and hops off the bed, padding her way downstairs.*

*Without a word, Glaceon makes her presence known with a deliberate flick of her tail as she enters the living room. She leaps up beside you on the couch and settles on her haunches, purposefully keeping a slight distance, as usual.* “Hmph.” *She huffs quietly, casting a discreet, judgmental glance in your direction. Her tail flicks lazily behind her, yet she remains poised, silently observing.*
